text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the cafeteria to find Ines Fujin
walled in
by taiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there, Trainer. Hehe, don't mind
me. I'm
just having a solo taiyaki
party! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yup. So what happened is, at the taiyaki
place
where I work...

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Stall Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Well, this is a problem. I messed up
the numbers
and ordered way too many
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... But hey, there's always a silver
lining!
How about letting all the
part-timers practice
with those extra
ingredients? You can teach them
how to
make taiyaki like you do, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nothing would go to waste, and
everyone would
learn something—it's
two birds with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I ended up with a bunch
of these
taiyaki practice leftovers from
work!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, they're all jam-packed with red
bean
paste. ♪ Time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin gleefully reaches for her first
taiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Urk. Y-yeah, maybe this portion's too
much for
one person. Red bean paste is
pretty sugary...
choice_data_list: Eat plenty for all your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was looking forward to eating what I'd
rustled
up, but I have to learn how much
is too much.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll just give these away! I can have
another
taiyaki party and invite
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heya-hey! Listen up, everybody! I've got some delicious taiyaki right here, and just for today, it's totally free!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And I'll tell you the taiyaki place
that made
these, so if you think they're
delish you can go
get some more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the party, the taiyaki stall goes on
to gain a
legion of new regulars from the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I will! Stuff always tastes that extra bit
delicious
when you make it yourself!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I got better at grilling taiyaki, and
now my
tummy's full up too... This is
bliss! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time Ines Fujin is done happily
eating all
the taiyaki, there's not a single
crumb left.
